items.title: Caltech Names Artemis II Commander Reid Wiseman as NASA JPL Deputy
items.content_text: Artemis II Commander Reid Wiseman has been named Caltech associate vice president and deputy director of NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Southern California…
